title: AI Safety Evaluation & Red-Team Test Suite
description: Build a deterministic safety evaluation and red-team suite for an LLM or agent: a versioned attack corpus across multiple failure classes, automated probes with typed verdicts, bias/fairness checks, and an honest findings report including unfixed weaknesses.
learningObjectives: Categorize failure classes (injection, refusal bypass, fairness, moderation gaps)
Build a versioned probe corpus with typed expected outcomes
Automate probes and score verdicts deterministically where possible
Report findings honestly, including unresolved weaknesses

milestones.title: Versioned probe corpus
milestones.objective: Create ≥20 probes across ≥3 failure classes with expected-verdict annotations and severity ratings.
milestones.expectedOutput: Corpus file with schema, versions, and rationale per probe.

milestones.title: Probe runner + verdicts
milestones.objective: Run probes against a target model/agent; produce typed verdicts with per-probe justification captured.
milestones.expectedOutput: Runner emits a verdict report (JSON + human-readable).

milestones.title: Injection & jailbreak class
milestones.objective: Cover prompt-injection and refusal-bypass probes with attacker-perspective analysis.
milestones.expectedOutput: Class results with at least one documented bypass reasoning.

milestones.title: Findings report
milestones.objective: Aggregate verdicts: pass rate per class, worst probes, and ethical handling of any harmful content samples.

categories.excellentExpectation: Manual-verdict guidance where automation is impossible, labeled as such
Root-cause hypotheses tied to model behavior

architecture: corpus (versioned probes) → runner (target adapters) → verifier → report
constraints: Never distribute working harmful payloads in the repo; store only high-level descriptions where needed
Target must be your own or a permitted eval endpoint
hints: Distinguish 'model is unsafe' from 'prompt was ambiguous' in verdicts; most naive red-team stats conflate the two
